# Calculations

```{R}
#| echo: false
library(testthat)
shift <- function(A, k = 1) {
  n <- if (is.matrix(A)) nrow(A) else length(A)
  k <- (-k) %% n
  if (k == 0) return(A)
  if (is.matrix(A)) {
    A[c((k + 1):n, 1:k), , drop = FALSE]
  } else {
    A[c((k + 1):n, 1:k)]
  }
}
```

### Setup
A symmetric circulant matrix with $n=6$ has independent components $a_0, a_1, a_2, a_3$ with the symmetry condition $a_k = a_{n-k}$.

### Constraints
**1. Block diagonal (L=3):** Sum of the 3×3 top-left block equals zero:
$$3a_0 + 4a_1 + 2a_2 = 0$$

**2. Global sum:** All elements of $A$ sum to zero:
$$a_0 + 2a_1 + 2a_2 + a_3 = 0$$

### Solution Space
Solving the two constraints gives a 2-dimensional solution space parameterized by $a_0$ and $a_1$:
$$a_2 = -\frac{3a_0 + 4a_1}{2}, \qquad a_3 = 2a_0 + 2a_1$$

### Minimum Norm Solution
Fixing $a_0 = 1$ and minimizing the Frobenius norm over $a_1$ gives $a_1 = -\frac{19}{20}$, and therefore:

$$a_0 = 20, \quad a_1 = -19, \quad a_2 = 8, \quad a_3 = 2$$

### Matrix
$$A = \begin{pmatrix} 20 & -19 & 8 & 2 & 8 & -19 \\ -19 & 20 & -19 & 8 & 2 & 8 \\ 8 & -19 & 20 & -19 & 8 & 2 \\ 2 & 8 & -19 & 20 & -19 & 8 \\ 8 & 2 & 8 & -19 & 20 & -19 \\ -19 & 8 & 2 & 8 & -19 & 20 \end{pmatrix}$$

# Notes
- $n=8, L=3$ comes out to the same solution as $n=8, L=2$.

```{R}
#| echo: false
make_coefs <- function(coefs, n) {
  # coefs = c(a0, a1, a2, ...) — the unique leading values
  L <- length(coefs)
  c(
    coefs, 
    rep(0, n - 2 * (L - 1) - 1), 
    rev(coefs[-1])
  ) / coefs[1]
}

ece <- function(A, x) drop(t(x) %*% A %*% x)

# Standard circulant test suite
test_suite <- function(A, n, L) {
  X_base <- matrix(rep(0, n), ncol = 1); X_base[1:L] <- 1

  testthat::test_that("Correct Length", {
    expect_equal(nrow(A), n)
  })

  testthat::test_that("Correct Output", {
    expect_equal(ece(A, shift(X_base, k = 0)), 0)
    expect_equal(ece(A, shift(X_base, k = 2)), 0)
    expect_equal(ece(A, shift(X_base, k = 3)), 0)

    X <- matrix(rep(0, n), ncol = 1); X[1:(L+1)] <- 1
    expect_equal(ece(A, X), 0)

    X <- matrix(rep(1, n), ncol = 1)
    expect_equal(ece(A, X), 0)
  })
}
```

## Optimization Problem
$$
\begin{aligned}
& \min_a \|A\|_F \\ 
& s.t. \|A_L\|_1 = 0, \\
& \qquad \|A_n\|_1 = 0
\end{aligned}
$$
It turns out that 
$$
\|A_L\|_1 = L a_0 + \sum_{i=1}^L 2(L-i)a_i. 
$$


--- 
```{R}
library(MASS)

# ---- Build Constraint Matrix C ----
make_constraint_matrix <- function(n, L) {
  half <- floor(n/2)
  ms <- L:half
  
  # Submatrix constraints: coefficients are 2*(l - k) for k = 0, ..., l
  # where k=0 gives l (not 2*l) so we adjust
  submatrix_row <- function(l) {
    coeffs <- pmax(2 * (l - 0:half), 0)  # 2*(l-k), clipped at 0
    coeffs[1] <- l                         # a0 gets l, not 2*l
    coeffs
  }
  
  # Global sum constraint: 1, 2, 2, ..., 2, 1
  global_row <- c(1, rep(2, half - 1), 1)
  
  # Stack rows
  C <- rbind(
    do.call(rbind, lapply(ms, submatrix_row)),
    global_row
  )
  
  rownames(C) <- c(paste0("m=", ms), "m=n")
  colnames(C) <- paste0("a", 0:half)
  C
}


# ---- Null Space ----
null_space <- function(C, tol=1e-10) {
  svd_C <- svd(C, nv = ncol(C))
  rank <- sum(svd_C$d > tol)
  svd_C$v[, (rank + 1):ncol(C), drop = FALSE]
}
```

```{R}

minimize_frobenius <- function(n, L) {
  half <- floor(n / 2)
  V    <- null_space(make_constraint_matrix(n, L))

  w <- c(1, rep(2, half - 1), 1)
  Q <- t(V) %*% diag(w) %*% V

  cvec       <- V[1, ]                                      # a0 = 1 constraint
  Qinv       <- solve(Q)
  alpha_star <- Qinv %*% cvec / drop(t(cvec) %*% Qinv %*% cvec)

  a_half <- drop(V %*% alpha_star)
  c(a_half, rev(a_half[-c(1, half + 1)]))
}

a <- minimize_frobenius(n = 6, L = 3)
A <- toeplitz(a)
```

```{R}
devtools::load_all("~/Documents/Research/Code/ECE")
lag_term <- function(x, y=x){
  if (is.matrix(x)) return(lag_term(x[,1], x[,2]))
  ((x - rotate(x, 1)) * (y - rotate(y, 1)) + 
    (rotate(x, 1) - rotate(x, 2)) * (rotate(y, 1) - rotate(y, 2)) - 
    (x - rotate(x, 2)) * (y - rotate(y, 2)))
}

lag_terms <- function(x, y = NULL) {
  if (is.matrix(x) && is.null(y)) {
    p <- ncol(x)
    idx <- combn(p, 2)
    do.call(cbind, map2(idx[1, ], idx[2, ], \(i, j) lag_term(x[, i], x[, j])))
  } else {
    if (is.null(y)) y <- x
    lag_term(x, y)
  }
}

split_indep <- function(x, stride = 3) {
  x <- as.matrix(x)
  map(1:stride, \(r) x[seq(r, nrow(x), stride), , drop = FALSE])
}

bs.multiplier <- function(s, B=100){
  n <- nrow(s)
  map_dbl(1:B, ~{
    z <- rnorm(n)
    max(abs(colMeans(z * s))) 
  })
}

cauchy.test <- function(pvals){
  T_stat <- mean(tan(pi * (1/2 - pvals)))
  #pcauchy(T_stat, lower.tail = FALSE)
  1/2 - atan(T_stat) / pi
}

ece.test.bs.multiplier <- function(X, B=1000){
  n <- nrow(X)

  # Make Terms Mean Zero and Independent
  splits <- lag_terms(X) |> split_indep()

  # Apply Bootstrap Multiplier
  bs_pval <- splits |>
    map_dbl(function(s) {
      stat_s <- max(abs(colMeans(s)))
      mean(bs.multiplier(s, B) > stat_s)
    })

  # Combine p-Values
  pval <- cauchy.test(bs_pval)
  pval
}
```

```{R}
resid_test <- function(X, method="", args=NULL){

  # Pearson Correlation
  resid <- remove.mean(X, method, args)  
  r <- cor(resid[, 1], resid[, 2])

  df <- n - K - 2
  t_stat <- r * sqrt(df) / sqrt(1 - r^2)
  pval <- 2 * pt(-abs(t_stat), df = df)

  list(statistic = t_stat, p.value = pval, df = df, r = r, K = K)
}
```

# Bootstrap Method

```{R}
devtools::load_all()

bs.parametric <- function(X, B=1000){

  # Calculate Variance of ECE Terms
  S <- lag_terms(X)
  W <- (1 / n^2) * (
    t(S) %*% S + 
    t(rotate(S)) %*% S + t(S) %*% rotate(S) + 
    t(rotate(S, 2)) %*% S + t(S) %*% rotate(S, 2)
  )

  # Boostrap Test
  S_bs <- MASS::mvrnorm(n=B, mu=rep(0, ncol(W)), Sigma=W)
  Q_bs <- abs(S_bs) |> apply(1, max)
  Q_obs <- max(abs(colMeans(S)))
  pval <- mean(Q_bs > Q_obs)
  pval
}

params <- scenario(2, n=n, p=p, r=0.0, L=2)
pval <- replicate(100, {
  X <- generate_data(params)
  bs.parametric(X, B=1000)
})
mean(pval < 0.1)
```

# Diagnostic: $\Sigma_Z$ 

```{R}
cov_Z <- function(params){
  n   <- params$n
  sx  <- sqrt(params$S[1, 1])
  sy  <- sqrt(params$S[2, 2])
  sxy <- params$S[1, 2]
  hx  <- params$h[, 1]
  hy  <- params$h[, 2]
  wx  <- lag_diff(hx) / n
  wy  <- lag_diff(hy) / n
  wxy <- lag_diff(hx, hy) / n

  rxy <- sxy / (sx * sy)

  k <- kappa_from_params(params)
  k22 <- k$k22
  k40 <- k$k40
  k04 <- k$k04
  k31 <- k$k31
  k13 <- k$k13

  S11 <- var_Tk_est(n, sx, wx, k40, k = 1)
  S12 <- cov_Th_Tk_est(n, sx, wx, k40)
  S13 <- cov_Tk_Rk_est(n, sx, sy, sxy, wxy, k22, k = 1)
  S14 <- cov_Th_Rk_est(n, sx, sy, sxy, wxy, k22)
  S15 <- cov_Tk_Qk_est(n, sx, sy, sxy, wx, wxy, k31, k = 1)
  S16 <- cov_Th_Qk_est(n, sx, sy, sxy, wx, wxy, k31)
  S22 <- var_Tk_est(n, sx, wx, k40, k = 2)
  S23 <- cov_Th_Rk_est(n, sx, sy, sxy, wxy, k22)
  S24 <- cov_Tk_Rk_est(n, sx, sy, sxy, wxy, k22, k = 2)
  S25 <- cov_Th_Qk_est(n, sx, sy, sxy, wx, wxy, k31)
  S26 <- cov_Tk_Qk_est(n, sx, sy, sxy, wx, wxy, k31, k = 2)
  S33 <- var_Tk_est(n, sy, wy, k04, k = 1)
  S34 <- cov_Th_Tk_est(n, sy, wy, k04)
  S35 <- cov_Tk_Qk_est(n, sy, sx, sxy, wy, wxy, k13, k = 1)
  S36 <- cov_Th_Qk_est(n, sy, sx, sxy, wy, wxy, k13)
  S44 <- var_Tk_est(n, sy, wy, k04, k = 2)
  S45 <- cov_Th_Qk_est(n, sy, sx, sxy, wy, wxy, k13)
  S46 <- cov_Tk_Qk_est(n, sy, sx, sxy, wy, wxy, k13, k = 2)
  S55 <- var_Qh_est(n, sx, sy, sxy, wx, wy, wxy, k22, k = 1)
  S56 <- cov_Qh_Qk_est(n, sx, sy, sxy, wx, wy, wxy, k22)
  S66 <- var_Qh_est(n, sx, sy, sxy, wx, wy, wxy, k22, k = 2)

  S_u_upper <- (1 / (4 * n^2)) * c(
    S11,
    S12, S22,
    S13, S23, S33,
    S14, S24, S34, S44,
    S15, S25, S35, S45, S55,
    S16, S26, S36, S46, S56, S66
  )
  S_u <- matrix(0, nrow = 6, ncol = 6)
  S_u[upper.tri(S_u, diag = TRUE)] <- S_u_upper
  S_u <- S_u + t(S_u) - diag(diag(S_u))
  S_u 
}

kappa_from_params <- function(params) {
  e <- generate_err(modifyList(params, list(n = 1e7)))
  ex <- e[, 1] / sqrt(params$S[1, 1])
  ey <- e[, 2] / sqrt(params$S[2, 2])
  list(
    k40 = mean(ex^4), k04 = mean(ey^4),
    k22 = mean(ex^2 * ey^2),
    k31 = mean(ex^3 * ey), k13 = mean(ex * ey^3)
  )
}
kappa_from_params(params)
```

```{R}
# Scenarios
# - Gaussian (r == 0)
# - Gaussian (r != 0)
# - Non-Gaussian (r == 0)
# - Non-Gaussian (r != 0)

params <- scenario(2, n=1000, L=4, err_type="exponential", r=0.5)

z_labels <- c("T1(X,X)", "T2(X,X)", "T1(Y,Y)", "T2(Y,Y)", "T1(X,Y)", "T2(X,Y)")

sim_Z_once <- function() {
  map_dfr(1:10, ~{
    X <- generate_data(params)
    matrix(c(
      lag_diff(X[,1], X[,1], k=1),
      lag_diff(X[,1], X[,1], k=2),
      lag_diff(X[,2], X[,2], k=1),
      lag_diff(X[,2], X[,2], k=2),
      lag_diff(X[,1], X[,2], k=1),
      lag_diff(X[,1], X[,2], k=2)
    ), nrow=1) |> as.data.frame()
  }) |> cov()
}

# 500 covariance estimates, each from 10 inner reps
cov_estimates <- map(1:500, ~sim_Z_once())

# Theoretical covariance matrix
S_z <- 4 * params$n^2 * cov_Z(params)

# Long format: one row per (outer rep, i, j) — upper triangle only
idx <- expand.grid(i = 1:6, j = 1:6) |> filter(i <= j)

cov_long <- imap_dfr(cov_estimates, ~{
  mat <- .x
  mutate(idx, rep = .y, value = mat[cbind(i, j)] - S_z[cbind(i, j)])
}) |> mutate(
  row_label = factor(z_labels[i], levels = z_labels),
  col_label = factor(z_labels[j], levels = z_labels)
)

vline_data  <- distinct(cov_long, row_label, col_label)
panel_stats <- cov_long |>
  summarise(
    median = median(value),
    p_val  = t.test(value)$p.value,
    .by    = c(row_label, col_label)
  ) |>
  mutate(label = paste0("p=", formatC(p_val, format = "g", digits = 2)))

cov_long |>
  ggplot(aes(x = value)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 40, fill = "steelblue", color = "white", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(data = vline_data,  aes(xintercept = 0),             color = "firebrick", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(data = panel_stats, aes(xintercept = median),        color = "orange",    linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_text( data = panel_stats, aes(x = Inf, y = Inf, label = label),
             hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.5, size = 2.5, color = "black") +
  facet_grid(row_label ~ col_label, scales = "free") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL,
       title = "Residuals: estimated - theoretical (n_inner=10, n_outer=500)",
       subtitle = "Red = theoretical (0), orange = sample median, p = t-test for bias") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(axis.text = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank())
```

```{R}
params_exp <- scenario(1, n = 1000, L = 4, r = 0.3, err_type="exponential")
params_norm <- scenario(1, n = 1000, L = 4, r = 0.3, err_type="normal")
kappa_from_params(params_exp)
kappa_from_params(params_norm)
```
